method: **Method:** Combine the grated coconut, sugar, and milk in a heavy-bottomed pan.
Cook on medium heat, stirring continuously.
When the mixture thickens and starts to leave the sides of the pan, add the color and essence.
Pour the mixture onto a greased plate and spread it evenly.
Let it cool for a few minutes and then cut into desired shapes.
**Method:** Stir grated coconut and sugar on low flame until they thicken.
Add cardamom and ghee, then pour onto a plate to cool and set.
